name: mcp-grafana-operation-batches-with-3166
instr:
mcp-grafana cannot execute dependency-aware operation batches through its alert-rule, routing, conversation, generation, experiment, and test-suite multiplexers. Implement batches combining existing reads and permitted mutations without changing validation, transport, pagination, conversion, write gating, response-size protections, or ordinary operations.

Require ordered, uniquely identified steps, backward-only dependencies, and explicit stop or continue policies. Reject structural invalidity before provider work. Resolve scalar predecessor values into copied arguments before provider decoding without mutating submitted arguments; invalid references fail only the consuming step.

Return one ordered terminal outcome per step: success, failure, dependency skip, cancellation, or stop-mode work not started. Cancellation prevents further requests. Apply failures to descendants and independent work according to policy. Enforce the aggregate response limit on the complete encoded result. Preserve every step's identifiers, fields, result shape, validation, dispatch, and remote errors across all six multiplexers.

Use bounded outer-operation, known-or-other step-operation, and `BatchStepState` metric dimensions, never caller-controlled labels. Preserve non-batch validation, routing, values, errors, and metric dimensions. Export the public batch model and executors from `github.com/grafana/mcp-grafana/tools`, and `BatchMetricDimensions` from `github.com/grafana/mcp-grafana/observabil
